title: The Long Descent
blurb: Three levels beneath the Shadowkeep, an old crown waits to be worn again.
interludes: The Warden lies in rubble, but the water beneath the keep still whispers. Somewhere in the flooded cisterns the Pale Chalice keeps the drowned dead sleeping — and something down there is trying to wake them. Rest, spend your spoils, and descend.
The Chalice is out of the dark and the flood recedes. Deeper still lies the Undercrown, a throne-hall of bone where the Warden's masters were crowned. End this — leave nothing alive in the deep.
epilogue: The Undercrown is silent. Dawn finds the heroes on the crypt steps, pockets heavy and shadows short. The Shadowkeep is bound once more — by their hand, and for good.
